doubts: A page of several separate short walks from Kerr Bay, so recorded as a network; W1 is main only because it is listed first. No road-end feature is clearly the Bellbird Walk car park 'near the east jetty at the end of Kerr Bay Road' or the Brunner Peninsula start 'on Kerr Bay Road, just below the Nelson Lakes Visitor Centre': F6 (where Kerr Bay Track meets Kerr Bay Road) is the only feature on Kerr Bay Road and could be either, so neither start is given a ref. Bellbird Walk is taken as a loop because 'The pathway returns through a small wetland area'. Honeydew Walk and Black Valley Walk give no end or shape. Map track T3 'Honeydew Track' is taken as the Honeydew Walk and T7 'Loop Track' as the St Arnaud Range/Loop Track (T9 'St. Arnaud Range Track' may be the same or a continuation). The Brunner Peninsula walk returns by streets (Baxter Street or Cotterell Street and View Road), so it is recorded as a loop back to Kerr Bay; where on the peninsula the 'next junction' of the longer option is, is not stated.
